text:
This looks like scrambled egg whites, or possibly an egg white scramble. The plate is a square, roughly 20-25 cm across, and the pile is fairly large. I estimate about 200 g of egg whites. Cooked egg white is about 52 kcal per 100 g, so 200 g is roughly 105 kcal. If the pile is actually whole egg or cheese such as paneer, the energy would be higher, but the pale white color and fluffy chunks fit egg whites best.
